## Having trouble {-}

If something is broken or you are stuck, the best thing you can do is **open an issue on the GitHub repository of the relevant component**:

* Firmware, hardware, scheduling, the REST API --- [DWARPH-firmware](https://github.com/DWARPHs/DWARPH-firmware/issues)
* The desktop dashboard, discovery, MQTT --- [DWARPH-GUI](https://github.com/DWARPHs/DWARPH-GUI/issues)
* This documentation --- [DWARPHs.github.io](https://github.com/DWARPHs/DWARPHs.github.io/issues)

An issue is more useful than an email: it is searchable, and the next person with the same problem finds the answer.

When reporting a device problem, it helps a great deal to include the firmware version, the device's `schedule.json` (with WiFi credentials removed), and the relevant part of the serial monitor or the GUI's `Debug` log.

## Contributing {-}

External contributions are welcome. There are several ways to help:

* Requesting features and reporting bugs through the GitHub issue tracker
* Sending pull requests to any of the existing repositories
* Improving this documentation --- every page has an **Edit** link in the top bar that takes you straight to its source
* Volunteering to maintain or develop a component
